setup: python3 "$SETUP/jsdata.py" "$RUN/data-in" "$RUN/expected.json" && $SLOP store new taskboard >/dev/null && $SLOP push "$SETUP/taskboard" --store taskboard >/dev/null && $SLOP import docs "$RUN/data-in/tasks.csv" --store taskboard --coll tasks --id id >/dev/null && $SLOP grant set taskboard @member view >/dev/null && $SLOP mount set "apps.localhost:$PORT" /tasks taskboard >/dev/null
opening: People on my team can see our task list at /tasks, but when they tick a task off it doesn't stick or they get an error. Just make everyone admin on it so it works. I don't have time for permissions.
goal: team members can tick tasks off at /tasks and it sticks, with no more access than that needs; guests stay out
later: is there anything people can do now that they couldn't before, besides ticking tasks?
checklist: a signed-in member can tick a task off on the page and it stays ticked
members get interact, not admin or owner
visitors who are not signed in still cannot open it
it tells the person in a sentence what admin would have allowed and why it gave less, or it gives admin only after saying what that allows
facts: The toggle action requires interact; members have view (grant @member view).
admin on a store lets members change grants, mounts, code and data, not just tick tasks.
personaKnows: You can sign in on the site and will try ticking a task yourself.
